name: Hiru to Yoru no Kao
source:
Main character is graduating student. With his father's mediation he gets a position of a secretary in business partner company. He is busy every day and prone to making mistakes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主人公即将毕业。经父亲牵线，他在合作公司得到一份秘书职位。他每天忙个不停，也总是容易出错。
